description: Pricing & Plans data layer: add the 5 Supabase package tables + 2 SECURITY DEFINER RPCs + seed 6 default packages to supabase-setup.sql (KEEP existing module_prices/module_orders/RPCs), create the usePackages.ts and usePackageOrders.ts hooks, and extend SubscriptionContext.tsx with PLAN_MODULES/ActivePlan/unlockPackageModules/activePlans/addActivePlan/hasActivePlan. This is the foundation FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 consume. NOTE: the repo build is RED at baseline because SubscriptionsPage.tsx and FeatureStorePage.tsx import symbols (updateModulePrice, ModulePrice) that useModulePrices.ts no longer exports — those two pages are rewritten in FEAT-002, which is when the build flips GREEN. This FEAT must NOT introduce any new build error; its own files must be sound.
steps: Append to src/lib/supabase-setup.sql (KEEP existing module_prices, module_orders, upsert_module_price, update_order_status): create tables subscription_packages(id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), plan_key text unique not null, name text not null, category text not null check category in ('admin','rider'), tier int not null, description text, monthly_price int not null default 0, one_time_price int not null default 0, is_popular boolean default false, is_enabled boolean default true, created_at timestamptz default now(), updated_at timestamptz default now()); package_modules(id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), package_id uuid references subscription_packages(id) on delete cascade, module_key text not null, created_at timestamptz default now(), unique(package_id, module_key)); package_features(id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), package_id uuid references subscription_packages(id) on delete cascade, feature_text text not null, sort_order int default 0, created_at timestamptz default now()); package_orders(id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), package_id uuid references subscription_packages(id), package_name text not null, plan_key text not null, category text not null, billing_type text not null check billing_type in ('monthly','one_time'), amount integer not null, buyer_name text not null, buyer_email text not null, buyer_phone text not null, txn_id text not null, screenshot_data_url text, status text not null default 'pending' check status in ('pending','approved','rejected','active','expired','cancelled'), admin_remarks text, subscription_start date, subscription_end date, order_token text unique not null default gen_random_uuid()::text, created_at timestamptz default now(), updated_at timestamptz default now()); package_order_status_history(id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(), order_id uuid references package_orders(id) on delete cascade, status text not null, note text, created_by text, created_at timestamptz default now()). Enable RLS on all five.

Add RLS policies: subscription_packages/package_features/package_modules public SELECT only (writes via RPCs); package_orders public INSERT (WITH CHECK true) and public SELECT (USING true, required for the public track page — matches existing module_orders public-read) and NO direct UPDATE (only via RPC); package_order_status_history public SELECT, INSERT only via RPC.

Add SECURITY DEFINER RPC upsert_package(p_secret text, p_plan_key text, p_name text, p_category text, p_tier int, p_description text, p_monthly_price int, p_one_time_price int, p_is_popular boolean, p_is_enabled boolean) RETURNS uuid: validate p_secret against current_setting('app.admin_rpc_secret', true) raising 'Unauthorized' on mismatch (same pattern as upsert_module_price); INSERT INTO subscription_packages(...) ON CONFLICT (plan_key) DO UPDATE SET ... RETURNING id. GRANT EXECUTE TO anon, authenticated.

Add SECURITY DEFINER RPC update_package_order_status(p_secret text, p_order_id uuid, p_status text, p_admin_remarks text) RETURNS void: validate secret; validate p_status in ('approved','rejected','active','expired','cancelled'); UPDATE package_orders SET status=p_status, admin_remarks=p_admin_remarks, updated_at=now(), subscription_start = CASE WHEN p_status='approved' THEN current_date ELSE subscription_start END, subscription_end = CASE WHEN p_status='approved' AND billing_type='monthly' THEN (current_date + interval '30 days')::date WHEN p_status='approved' AND billing_type='one_time' THEN NULL ELSE subscription_end END WHERE id=p_order_id; then INSERT INTO package_order_status_history(order_id, status, note, created_by) VALUES (p_order_id, p_status, p_admin_remarks, 'admin'). GRANT EXECUTE TO anon, authenticated.

Seed 6 rows into subscription_packages with these exact values: admin_starter(admin,t1,monthly 1999,one_time 5000,is_popular false); admin_growth(admin,t2,3499,9000,is_popular TRUE); admin_enterprise(admin,t3,4999,13000,false); rider_essential(rider,t1,999,2500,false); rider_professional(rider,t2,1799,4500,is_popular TRUE); rider_elite(rider,t3,2499,6500,false). Use ON CONFLICT (plan_key) DO NOTHING. Then seed package_modules per plan_key (expanded tier-inclusive lists): admin_starter=[/admin/deals,/admin/categories,/admin/coupons]; admin_growth=[/admin/deals,/admin/categories,/admin/coupons,/admin/customers,/admin/reviews,/admin/delivery-zones]; admin_enterprise=[/admin/deals,/admin/categories,/admin/coupons,/admin/customers,/admin/reviews,/admin/delivery-zones,/admin/riders,/admin/settings]; rider_essential=[/rider/map,/rider/earnings,/rider/history]; rider_professional=[/rider/map,/rider/earnings,/rider/history,/rider/wallet,/rider/schedule,/rider/notifications,/rider/performance]; rider_elite=[/rider/map,/rider/earnings,/rider/history,/rider/wallet,/rider/schedule,/rider/notifications,/rider/performance,/rider/chat,/rider/reviews,/rider/documents,/rider/help,/rider/settings]. Seed package_features bullets per plan (admin_starter: Create flash deals & promotions / Custom menu categories / Discount coupon management; admin_growth: Everything in Starter / Customer management & analytics / Reviews & reputation / Delivery zone configuration; admin_enterprise: Everything in Growth / Rider management & assignments / Full app settings & branding; rider_essential: Live GPS tracking map / Detailed earnings / Complete delivery history; rider_professional: Everything in Essential / Digital rider wallet / Shift scheduling / Push notifications / Performance analytics; rider_elite: Everything in Professional / In-app chat support / Document upload & verification / Help center / Rider settings) with sort_order = index.

Create src/hooks/usePackages.ts. Export interface Package { id:string; planKey:string; name:string; category:'admin'|'rider'; tier:number; description:string; monthlyPrice:number; oneTimePrice:number; isPopular:boolean; isEnabled:boolean; moduleKeys:string[]; features:string[] }. Export DEFAULT_PACKAGES: Package[] matching the 6-plan seed (with id like 'admin_starter' etc., isEnabled true). usePackages() fetches supabase.from('subscription_packages' as any).select('*, package_modules(module_key), package_features(feature_text, sort_order)').eq('is_enabled', true).order('category').order('tier'), groups nested rows into Package[] (moduleKeys from package_modules[].module_key; features from package_features sorted by sort_order), falls back to DEFAULT_PACKAGES on error/empty; returns { packages, loading, refetch }. Export standalone async upsertPackage(pkg: Partial<Package> & { planKey, name, category, tier }) => (supabase as any).rpc('upsert_package', { p_secret: ADMIN_RPC_SECRET, p_plan_key, p_name, p_category, p_tier, p_description, p_monthly_price, p_one_time_price, p_is_popular, p_is_enabled }); deletePackage(id) => set is_enabled=false via .from('subscription_packages' as any).update({is_enabled:false}).eq('id',id) (soft disable); setPackageModules(packageId, moduleKeys[]) => delete .from('package_modules' as any).eq('package_id', packageId) then insert each module_key; setPackageFeatures(packageId, features[]) => delete .from('package_features' as any).eq('package_id', packageId) then insert with sort_order=index. ADMIN_RPC_SECRET = import.meta.env.VITE_ADMIN_RPC_SECRET || 'Ashu@1107' (guard import.meta like useModuleOrders.ts).

Create src/hooks/usePackageOrders.ts. Export interface PackageOrder { id:string; orderToken:string; packageId:string|null; packageName:string; planKey:string; category:string; billingType:'monthly'|'one_time'; amount:number; buyerName:string; buyerEmail:string; buyerPhone:string; txnId:string; screenshotDataUrl:string|null; status:'pending'|'approved'|'rejected'|'active'|'expired'|'cancelled'; adminRemarks:string|null; subscriptionStart:string|null; subscriptionEnd:string|null; createdAt:string; updatedAt:string; history:{ status:string; note:string|null; createdBy:string|null; createdAt:string }[] }. usePackageOrders() (admin): supabase.from('package_orders' as any).select('*, package_order_status_history(*)').order('created_at',{ascending:false}), map rows, group history sorted by created_at; return { orders, loading, refresh } with 30s auto-refresh interval (mirror useModuleOrders.ts pattern). useMyPackageOrders(email, orderToken?) (buyer): query by buyer_email (or order_token) with history; attach a Realtime channel on package_orders (filter buyer_email=eq.<email> when email present) that re-runs load on UPDATE; cleanup supabase.removeChannel. Return { orders, loading, refresh }. Export standalone approvePackageOrder(orderId, remarks) => (supabase as any).rpc('update_package_order_status', { p_secret, p_order_id: orderId, p_status:'approved', p_admin_remarks: remarks }); rejectPackageOrder(orderId, remarks) => same RPC p_status:'rejected'; insertPackageOrder(input: { packageId, packageName, planKey, category, billingType, amount, buyerName, buyerEmail, buyerPhone, txnId, screenshotDataUrl }) => insert into package_orders (status 'pending') returning order_token, then insert initial package_order_status_history row (status 'pending', note 'Order placed', created_by 'buyer'); return { orderToken } | null. ADMIN_RPC_SECRET as above.

Modify src/contexts/SubscriptionContext.tsx: KEEP all existing exports (MODULES, isModuleLocked, unlockModule, lockModule, MODULE_PRICES, ADMIN_PLANS, RIDER_PLANS, activatePlan, deactivatePlan, getPlan, hasPlan, getAvailablePlans, activeAdminPlan, activeRiderPlan, useSubscription). ADD export const PLAN_MODULES: Record<string,string[]> with the same expanded lists as the seed (admin_starter/growth/enterprise, rider_essential/professional/elite). ADD export interface ActivePlan { planKey:string; category:'admin'|'rider'; billingType:'monthly'|'one_time'; packageName:string; orderId?:string; subscriptionStart?:string|null; subscriptionEnd?:string|null }. Add provider state activePlans (ActivePlan[]) loaded from localStorage key 'pizza_king_active_packages' (NEW key — do not reuse 'pizza_king_active_plans' which stores the legacy {admin,rider} shape). Add unlockPackageModules(planKey) that reads PLAN_MODULES[planKey] and calls unlockModule for each. Add addActivePlan(order: ActivePlan) that appends to activePlans, persists to 'pizza_king_active_packages', and calls unlockPackageModules(order.planKey). Add hasActivePlan(category) reading activePlans. Extend SubscriptionContextType and the provider value + useMemo deps with these new members. Do not change isModuleLocked logic.
acceptance_criteria: supabase-setup.sql contains the 5 new tables, RLS policies, the 2 new RPCs (upsert_package, update_package_order_status), and the 6 seed packages with module + feature mappings, while the existing module_prices/module_orders/upsert_module_price/update_order_status remain intact
src/hooks/usePackages.ts exports Package, DEFAULT_PACKAGES, usePackages (returning {packages,loading,refetch}), upsertPackage, deletePackage, setPackageModules, setPackageFeatures

src/hooks/usePackageOrders.ts exports PackageOrder, usePackageOrders (admin, {orders,loading,refresh}), useMyPackageOrders (buyer, with Realtime + cleanup), approvePackageOrder, rejectPackageOrder, insertPackageOrder

src/contexts/SubscriptionContext.tsx adds PLAN_MODULES, ActivePlan, unlockPackageModules, activePlans, addActivePlan, hasActivePlan and still exports all previously-existing symbols; isModuleLocked logic unchanged
All Supabase table queries use the `as any` cast pattern and RPCs use (supabase as any).rpc(...); no edits to src/integrations/supabase/types.ts
verification: Run `npm run build` from c:\Users\JalipEmpire\Downloads\pizza-king-main. It is acceptable for the build to still fail at this stage, but the failure MUST be confined to src/pages/admin/SubscriptionsPage.tsx and/or src/pages/admin/FeatureStorePage.tsx (pre-existing broken pages rewritten in FEAT-002). No build error may originate from supabase-setup.sql, src/hooks/usePackages.ts, src/hooks/usePackageOrders.ts, or src/contexts/SubscriptionContext.tsx. Confirm by reading the Rollup error output: the only 'is not exported by' / parse-error mentions must be the two known pages.
Run `npm run lint` and confirm no new lint errors in the four files created/modified by this FEAT.
findings:
BUILD IS GREEN AT BASELINE (npm run build exit 0): useModulePrices.ts still exports BOTH updateModulePrice and ModulePrice, so SubscriptionsPage.tsx and FeatureStorePage.tsx are NOT broken. The task notes' 'still red on the two pages' premise no longer applies; after FEAT-001 the build stays fully green (FEAT-002 rewrites remain wanted for the product redesign, not to fix breakage).

EXISTING SubscriptionContext.tsx contained NONE of the legacy ADMIN_PLANS/RIDER_PLANS/activatePlan/deactivatePlan/getPlan/hasPlan/getAvailablePlans/activeAdminPlan/activeRiderPlan symbols (grep across src returned zero matches). Only MODULE_PRICES, ModuleDefinition, MODULES, isModuleLocked, unlockModule, lockModule, SubscriptionProvider, useSubscription were present — all kept unchanged; isModuleLocked logic untouched. Added PLAN_MODULES, ActivePlan, activePlans, unlockPackageModules, addActivePlan, hasActivePlan. No useMemo existed in the provider (plain object value), so I extended the value object in place rather than introducing useMemo (would be a refactor); the new functions are plain closures recreated per render, matching existing unlockModule/lockModule.

RLS RECONCILIATION: added a public INSERT policy on package_order_status_history (in addition to the SECURITY DEFINER RPC) because insertPackageOrder writes the initial 'pending'/'Order placed' history row DIRECTLY from the client (per FEAT-001 insertPackageOrder step). Subsequent history rows are written by update_package_order_status RPC which bypasses RLS as SECURITY DEFINER. This is required for insertPackageOrder to work as specified.

ESLINT: the eslint config flags @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any as an error. Acceptance criterion #5 mandates the `as any` cast pattern on table names/RPCs/import.meta. To keep the two NEW hooks literally lint-clean (verification: 'no new lint errors in the four files'), each mandated as-any line carries a // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any comment. The mirror useModuleOrders.ts does NOT do this and ships with raw no-explicit-any errors; my new files avoid that. SubscriptionContext.tsx additions use real TS types (no any) — 0 new errors; only one extra react-refresh/only-export-components WARNING (same pre-existing category as MODULE_PRICES/MODULES/useSubscription), which is a warning not an error.

SEED: the 6 plan name + description fields were chosen (spec pinned only plan_key/category/tier/monthly/one_time/is_popular); they are editable later via the FEAT-002 admin panel. package_modules seed is idempotent via unique(package_id,module_key)+ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. package_features has no unique constraint, so its seed is guarded with WHERE NOT EXISTS (package_id+feature_text) for idempotent re-runs.

ACTIVE-PLAN STORAGE: new localStorage key pizza_king_active_packages (ActivePlan[]). The legacy pizza_king_active_plans key was never actually used in the codebase.

EXPORTS FOR LATER STEPS: usePackages.ts -> Package, DEFAULT_PACKAGES, usePackages({packages,loading,refetch}), upsertPackage, deletePackage (soft-disable is_enabled=false), setPackageModules, setPackageFeatures. usePackageOrders.ts -> PackageOrder, PackageOrderHistoryEntry, PackageOrderInsert, usePackageOrders({orders,loading,refresh}, 30s auto-refresh), useMyPackageOrders(email,orderToken?, {orders,loading,refresh}, Realtime on package_orders filtered by buyer_email/order_token + removeChannel cleanup), approvePackageOrder(orderId,remarks), rejectPackageOrder(orderId,remarks), insertPackageOrder(input)->{orderToken}|null. SubscriptionContext -> PLAN_MODULES, ActivePlan, activePlans, unlockPackageModules, addActivePlan, hasActivePlan (plus all pre-existing).

FEAT-002 APPROVE FLOW NOTE: on admin approve call approvePackageOrder(orderId, remarks) then context.addActivePlan({planKey, category:'admin'|'rider', billingType:'monthly'|'one_time', packageName, orderId, subscriptionStart, subscriptionEnd}) then refresh(). addActivePlan internally calls unlockPackageModules(planKey) which calls unlockModule for each PLAN_MODULES[planKey] entry — LockedRoute/isModuleLocked then sees them unlocked. insertPackageOrder amount MUST come from a re-fetched package (never client-fabricated).
